title: Ultra-Premium Commercial Fashion Advertising (ZARA)
full_prompt: Ultra-premium commercial fashion advertising posters for the brand ZARA. Visual Hierarchy: The jacket must hold 70-75% of the visual importance, while the model holds only 25-30%. Reference Lock: Strict instructions to preserve the exact model identity (facial structure, hair, skin tone) and the exact garment details (colors, patches, stitching, materials). Intent: The output should look like a "Behance front-page" global brand campaign, not a catalog photo. Focus: High-contrast luxury street luxury. Format: Vertical 4:5, 8K UHD. Color Palette: Deep cobalt blue (#0B2D89), Rich varsity yellow (#F3B51A), Pure white, rich black, metallic silver. Composition: Aggressive crop from waist upward; large negative space for typography. Pose: Dynamic torso twist, head turned away, face de-emphasized to highlight garment structure. Lighting: High-end commercial lighting with sharp rim lights tracing the jacket outline and hard specular highlights on sleeves.
creator: @Diplomeme

title: Oriental Music Visual Poster (东方音乐视觉海报)
full_prompt: 请生成一张 9:16 竖版、原创高级东方音乐视觉海报。主题乐器：[古琴 / 琵琶 / 竹笛 / 箜篌 / 古筝 / 编钟 / 二胡] 主题方向：[古琴水纹 / 琵琶金音 / 笛音青岚 / 箜篌星音] 主色调：[月白、墨青、淡金 / 朱砂红、暖金、米白 / 青绿、玉白、雾灰 / 月白、淡紫、冷金] 声音视觉化元素：[水纹 / 金色音轨 / 青色风线 / 星轨弦光 / 回响圆环 / 墨色音波] 整体风格为东方水墨时装插画，结合东方乐器、新中式幻想高定、宣纸质感、水墨留白、半透明纱层、细金线描绘与现代东方审美。画面主体是一位修长优雅的东方女性，气质高级、空灵、安静或灵动。人物姿态必须服务于乐器演奏，例如坐姿抚琴、抱琵琶拨弦、侧身吹笛、静坐拂箜篌弦。乐器必须清晰可见，是画面的视觉锚点。请强化乐器器形、弦线、木质感、装饰细节 and 东方美感。把声音画出来：让音波变成书法线条、水墨气流、金色音轨、水纹涟漪、青色风线或星轨弦光，并与人物衣袖、发丝、披帛和裙摆自然融合。服装为原创东方幻想高定礼服，带半透明纱层、柔和垂坠、水墨晕染、细腻褶皱和局部细金线。背景白而不空，带轻宣纸纹理、浅雾层和淡水墨气层。整体画面要高级、干净、空灵、东方、音乐感强，有品牌海报感。不要文字、不要书法字、不要标题、不要签名、不要 logo、不要水印、不要拼图。每次只生成一张独立图片。
creator: @MrLarus

title: Studio Archive Animation Visual Development
full_prompt: Create an image that looks like a hand-painted animation development plate from an old studio archive. Composition & Shape: Dominant Silhouette must be readable as a B&W shape before color. Exaggerated Proportion using design logic (e.g., swollen masses, pinched transitions, awkward imbalance). Vertical Rhythm: Subjects should rise, slump, or stretch; maintain strong negative space. Color Palette: Desaturated blue-gray, green-gray, smoke teal, bone white, ink black, dirty cream, and cold shadow. Black for structure, white for light, blue-gray for silence. Value & Rendering: Pale light, muted atmospheric midtone, and heavy ink shadow. Mediums: Ink, dry brush, digital gouache, and worn print texture. Surface Detail: Must show drag, pressure, scrape, grain, rubbed edges, and uneven pigment. Line Work: Variable Weight, thick at weight, thin at tension, broken at lost edges. Emotional Edges: Sharp protrusions for bite, drooping curves/sagging fabric for fatigue, age, or defeat.
creator: @IamEmily2050
